metrics.name: Primary record accessibility
metrics.numerator: In-scope required original manifestations retrievable with verified sha256

metrics.name: Publication latency
metrics.numerator: UTC publication timestamp minus event UTC
metrics.denominator: Each event with independently evidenced timestamps
metrics.target: Alert on material delay based on law-specific deadlines

metrics.name: Reporting unit identity coverage
metrics.denominator: Complete authoritative CEE epoch-specific unit inventory

metrics.name: Result row conservation
metrics.numerator: Classified real source rows including unresolved

metrics.name: Result reproducibility
metrics.numerator: Certified totals reproduced from original bound actas

metrics.name: Custody chain closure
metrics.denominator: All required transitions for actual item IDs

metrics.name: Disposition traceability
metrics.numerator: Cases with official final disposition and legal stage
metrics.denominator: In-scope cases with authoritative case IDs

metrics.name: Detector quality
metrics.numerator: TP, FP, FN from blinded labeled historical/synthetic examples
metrics.target: Defined after independent baseline; do not invent

proposed_sla.source_change_detection: 24h from verified official publication if source accessible
